versions.changelog:
Initial release — authoritative Java design patterns and principles reference.

- Covers 182 design patterns across 15 categories, plus 26 core programming principles.
- Includes GoF 23 standard patterns, enterprise architecture, concurrency, and microservice patterns.
- Provides concise Java code samples for 7 essential patterns for quick reference.
- Quick index and documentation links for all included design principles (KISS, DRY, SOLID, etc.).
- Prioritizes answering "why" via principles before "how" with specific patterns.
- Automatically triggers for user questions on design patterns, principles, architecture, or Java implementations.
